reason: A DeepSeek Harness control panel for monitoring and operating Tailscale-based remote access, including health checks, HTTPS Serve control, macOS proxy bypass, relay operations, and ACL snippet generation.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Tailscale 远程访问的状态监控、健康检查、HTTPS 入口控制、代理绕过、 中继运维和 ACL 片段生成。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness control panel for Tailscale remote-access monitoring, health checks, HTTPS Serve control, proxy bypass, relay operations, and ACL snippet generation.

capabilities: Reads Tailscale device and network status
Runs allowlisted local Tailscale and macOS proxy commands
Performs relay-server operations through configured SSH access
